SCHEDULE A - INITIAL CONTRACT PRICE

The Initial Contract Price shall be the United States Dollar ______________________ (Amount in words: United States Dollar _____________________ only); inter alia, including i) United States Dollars ___________________ (Amount in words: United States Dollar ______________________________ only) of Lump Sum Initial Contract for the Base Scope of the Supply of the GOODS, and ii) United States Dollar ___________________ (Amount in words: United States Dollar ___________________only) of the Lump Sum Initial Contract Price for the Optional Scope of Supply of the GOODS.

The Lump Sum Initial Contract Price shall be adjusted according to the Purchase Order actually placed for the Optional Scope of Supply.

B.html:
SCHEDULE B - PAYMENT TERMS AND SCHEDULE

Payment for Base Scope of Supply

Payment for Base Scope of Supply shall be paid on the basis of the Lump Sum Initial Contract Price for Base Scope of Supply, and the payment terms and the sequence set forth in the table below:

No.

Payment Terms

Percentage (%)

of Initial Contract Price for Base Scope of Supply

Advance Payment

Upon signing of the Purchase Agreement and Approval of

Advance Payment Guarantee,

Performance Bank Guarantee,

Detail Work Time Schedule, and

Undisputed corresponding invoice.

10.00%

Milestone No.1

Upon Approval of

All engineering design drawings and documents for the GOODS, and

Undisputed corresponding invoice.

5.00%

Milestone No.2

Upon Approval of

Placement of the purchase order by VENDOR for the fabrication of the Major Raw Materials and Purchased Components, and

Undisputed corresponding invoice.

15.00%

Milestone No.3

Upon Approval of

Ready for Shipment /Transportation including Final Inspection/Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) and acceptance of Bill of Lading (B/L)/Air Waybill (AWB),

Duly signed and stamped Notice of VENDOR for deduction of the Advance Payment, and

Undisputed corresponding Invoice.

30.00%

Milestone No.4

Upon

issuance of Material Receiving Certificate at the SITE and

Approval of undisputed corresponding invoice.

20.00%

Milestone No.5

Upon

issuance of Provisional Acceptance Certificate from PURCHASER to VENDOR, and

Approval of undisputed corresponding invoice.

10.00%

Milestone No.6

Upon

issuance of Final Acceptance Certificate from PURCHASER to VENDOR, and

Approval of undisputed corresponding invoice.

10.00%

　TOTAL

100.00%

Payment for Optional Scope of Supply

Payment for Optional Scope of Supply shall be paid on the basis of each Purchaser Order placed by PURCHASER and the payment terms and conditions contained therein.

Payment for Change Order

Payment for Change Order issued in accordance with the AGREEMENT shall be made within forty-five (45) days upon

Completion Certificate issued by PURCHASER to VENDOR after all relevant Work(s) required in the Change Order is fully completed, inspected, accepted and confirmed by the PURCHASER; and

Undisputed invoice for as per the price for the Change Order determined in accordance with Sub-Article 21.6 of the AGREEMENT.

No reimbursement, compensation or payment whatsoever shall be payable other than for Change Orders issued pursuant to this AGREEMENT.
